origin.description: Splits the interval and applies Gauss-Kronrod, Clenshaw-Curtis, or adaptive Simpson. Infinite limits use quadinf.
origin.usage: integral(fun, xmin, xmax, method = c('Kronrod', 'Clenshaw', 'Simpson'), no_intervals = 8, random = FALSE, reltol = 1e-8, abstol = 0, ...)

arguments.name: method
arguments.text: Kronrod, Clenshaw, or Simpson. A unique prefix is enough.

arguments.name: random
arguments.text: Place the interior breaks at random.

origin.details: sin from 0 to pi by Kronrod on 4 pieces
origin.value: Splits the interval and applies Gauss-Kronrod, Clenshaw-Curtis, or adaptive Simpson. Infinite limits use quadinf.
